normal: yielded, worker gone, database open, no application close, cleanup errors empty, tasks drained
blocked: yielded, stored worker alive, stop event set, elapsed 1.5 to 4.5 seconds, cleanup errors empty, status text absent from logs, database retained, tasks drained, stop function not wrapped
corrupt_and_broker: did not yield, worker not alive, database not open
cancelled: CancelledError, worker still alive, cleanup errors empty, database open, owned tasks done
